title: South Savo: 2.4 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €111,920 a year
markdown:
# South Savo: 2.4 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €111,920 a year

> Closes 2.4 of 3.2 missing patients a year (74%) · €111,920 of €1M · €888,080 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in South Savo, 23 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. The difference is within what chance alone gives a county of this size. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, 6.2 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 2.5–9.6). [^care_curative][^model] Against Finland as a whole, the shortfall of 3.2 patients a year splits into 2.5 fewer operated and 0.7 fewer given radiotherapy that aims to cure. [^care_curative][^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 23.4% to 26.0% by 2028: 2.4 more patients a year (range 0.0–3.1), for €111,920 a year, about €47,424 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 74% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (3.2 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €19,920 | 0.7 (0.0–1.4) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 23.4% → 24.2% by 2028 |
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 2 | **Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate**[^ev_surgeon_second_opinion_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; chief of thoracic surgery at the university hospital | €41,000 | 1.1 (0.0–1.7) | Agree with the university hospital that a thoracic surgeon joins the weekly lung meeting, and send last quarter's stage I-II patients who were not operated for a second look. | Share of patients operated: 12.2% → 13.4% by 2028 |
| 3 | **Video MDT review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital**[^ev_video_mdt_stage1_3_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; lead of the university hospital lung MDT | €51,000 | 0.6 (0.0–0.6) | Ask the university hospital for a fixed weekly video slot and list every stage I-III patient diagnosed last month who was not discussed there. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 23.4% → 24.0% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€111,920** | **2.4 (0.0–3.1)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €404,432 a year; modelled to avoid 0.7 deaths a year (0.1–1.8). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 23.4% (2019–2023, measured) → 26.0% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients operated: 12.2% → 13.4% by 2028. [^care_surgery][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

In the model, the remaining €888,080 buys nothing more for treatment that aims to cure. The measures are limited by the reachable shortfall, not by money. [^model] Other options are low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or ranking measures by deaths avoided. [^model] Lung cancer causes 70.8 deaths a year in South Savo, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.4 of them (range 0.0–0.93). [^deaths][^model]

## Pilot ask

Pilot: South Savo wellbeing services county + the KYS collaborative area, 6 months: (1) thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, (2) stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated. KPI: share of patients treated to cure 23.4% → 26.0% by 2028. [^model]

## Limits

- No trial has measured these effects; they are assumptions. Each range runs from all assumptions at their lowest to all at their highest, and is not a probability. [^model]
- The expected share is adjusted only for the share of residents aged 65 or over, not for stage, fitness, histology, smoking or recording completeness. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- A check found 0 of 3 measured outcomes matched the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock beyond chance. [^model]

removed.sentence: The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used in this plan.
removed.reason: The material calls the clock a secondary view and not a headline number; it does not say the clock is unused in this plan.

flagged.sentence: The remaining €888,080 buys nothing more for treatment that aims to cure.
flagged.reason: This is a model result, not an observed fact. Added 'In the model' as the source does ('buys nothing more in the model').

flagged.sentence: More would come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or from ranking measures by deaths avoided.
flagged.reason: The material only points to these as other options to look at. It gives no estimate that they would yield more, so the sentence was rewritten as 'Other options are…'.

flagged.sentence: Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage, fitness, histology, smoking or recording completeness.
flagged.reason: The measured shares are not adjusted. Only the expected share is adjusted, and only for the share of residents aged 65 or over. Reworded to say this.

flagged.sentence: A check found 0 of 3 measured outcomes matched it beyond chance.
flagged.reason: Named the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock directly, because the preceding sentence that introduced 'it' was removed.
